note: B25 Office de tourisme, ground floor: the map room (La salle des cartes), camera at the doorway from the hall. Deep teal-blue walls hung with antique maps, cream stone floor; landmark: the enormous antique world map on the back wall with its rolling ladder. Feminine LEFT: father bear showing his cub the way to fold a map (façon); deer in a captain's coat turning the brass pointer (direction); zebra with a paint roller inside its freshly striped zone (zone). Masculine RIGHT: polar bear gnawing an icicle (nord); ginger cat sauntering onto the bullseye of the target mat (centre); wooden chair with a navy coat hung over its side (côté); stork in its nest on the sunny window sill (est); model windmill with a mouse miller in the middle of the bench (milieu). Exits: doorway near left -> hall R_world_01; white arch back right -> town-plan alcove R_abs_space_01_z2; zoom on the chart table -> R_abs_space_01_z1. Painted 2026-10-22 (track s08p3). 2026-10-22: fox tailor replaced by a chair with a coat over its side (user hook qa_020: a COAT hangs over the SIDE of a chair); source _work/p2/b25_maproom_c_cote.jpg (full-image edit of maproom_b).
